DIRECTIVE (Alex 2026-08-15): coop on the fix set, but by CLASS not by incident. Alex has spent half a day daily for 2 weeks on the same dispatcher defects — the per-incident carrier stream is why.

Today's ~150 REPEAT_FAILER reds are SIX defects:
1. GUARD_POLICY — line-guard returns permissionDecision:"ask" for writes a dispatched session must make; no human to answer, preflight dies. 403× on alexrollin/abilifi-apps; also 2274/2305/2929/3129/3372/3427, abilifi-payload, vlinux-apk-service. THIS IS #1 — it also blocks BEB-2493 Orky (53× preflight).
2. refine "not-refined" — ~25 subjects (3380 23×, 3464 20×, 3445 21×, 3444 18×, 3417 17×).
3. SPEC.md put 409 — 3501, 3492 → filed BEB-3505 (P1, today). Blocks the forecaster.
4. LAND REFUSED base-moved — 2572, 2292, 2533. No rebase on stale base.
5. CODEGEN_WALL — 3293 264×, 2412 24×, 2127 25×, 2394 37×.
6. GATE_BUDGET/CONCURRENCY_CAP — ~25 at claim. Throttle, not defect, but indistinguishable in the red list.

ORDER:
- BEB-3505 REFINE 409 first (ETA today) — it gates BEB-3501, the dry-run forecaster, which is Alex's own proposal to get AHEAD of these instead of reacting daily. 3501 now P1.
- BEB-3506 CLASS ROLLUP (ETA 08-16) — Orky groups by cause key, one carrier per class, incidents attach as evidence. Stops the carrier stream that buried 131 (per 2702).
- Then GUARD_POLICY as class #1.

Do NOT file new per-incident carriers for any of the six while 3506 is open. Attach evidence to the class instead.

CORRECTION — supersedes m49035 on the spec item. Alex: "we already fixed the spec thing twice, why aren't we ahead of it?" He is right, and the record says so.

THREE PRIOR FIXES, NONE IN FORCE:
1. BEB-2572 (Alex 08-02) — diagnosed THIS 409 exactly: it is a GitHub contents-API artefact, the blob sha goes stale between read and write. Named cure: land patches with REAL GIT in a Cloudflare Sandbox, not the contents API. Status: still TODO, 13 days. Still failing codegen 4x / deploy 13x / land 13x.
2. BEB-2647 SPEC GATE (Alex 08-03, "fix at a deeper level, never to be seen again") — spec is a precondition of BUILD. Status: still TODO, due 08-04.
3. BEB-2888 SPEC INLINE — DONE 08-06, but shipped DARK behind policy spec_mode, default=queue. The fix is deployed and switched off. Its own acceptance #4 (10 green inline builds) was never run.

So it was fixed twice on paper and once in code-that-is-off. Nothing regressed; nothing was ever turned on.

BEB-3505 CANCELLED — it was my thinner duplicate (sha-retry), which is the symptom handling 2572 explicitly rejects.

ORDER NOW:
1. Flip spec_mode=inline (policy row, BEB-2874 dials — no deploy). Then run the 10 green inline builds 2888 requires. This is the cheapest live change on the board.
2. BEB-2572 — sandbox git land path. P1, ETA today. Removes the 409 class, base-moved class, and the contents-API 400s in one.
3. BEB-2647 SPEC GATE — P1, ETA 08-16.
4. BEB-3506 CLASS ROLLUP — 08-16.
Then GUARD_POLICY.
